- If sentiment is positive (≥ 0.25) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- If sentiment is negative (≤ -0.25) in recent days, model tends to underestimate prices; increase forecast slightly.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +5%+ in 3-5 days); apply a 1-2 day lag correction downward.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 20% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next 3-5 days.
- For 30-day horizon, model frequently overestimates early in the forecast window; apply a 1-3 day downward bias to first 5-7 days.
- If sentiment is volatile (alternating +/–), model tends to overfit short-term noise; smooth forecast with 3-day moving average.
